# bash completion for codepunk
_codepunk_completion() {
  local cur prev command
  COMPREPLY=()
  cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
  prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
  command="${COMP_WORDS[1]}"
  case "$prev" in
    completion)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "bash zsh fish" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    sessions)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "tree graph prune search" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    trust)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "status grant revoke" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    permissions)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "profile approval reviewer autonomy sandbox filesystem rules insights why" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    mcp)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list add remove test login logout status" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    skills)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list add remove" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    plugins)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list add remove enable disable" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    memory)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list search add edit delete archive export" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    models)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list test set auth remove import" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    config)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "show path" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --mode)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "text json" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --permission-mode)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "read-only standard auto auto-approve full-access" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --approval)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "ask deny auto allow" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --autonomy)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "read-only ask scoped" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --sandbox)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "required uncovered" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --filesystem)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "workspace full" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --thinking)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "off low medium high xhigh" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --verdict)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "complete incomplete" -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --add-dir|--scoped-rules|--headless-policy|--output|--socket|--prefix)
      COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
      return 0
      ;;
    --mode|--json-schema|--session|--fork|--worktree|--new-session-id|--parent-session-id|--model|--provider|--thinking|--tools|--model-fallback|--permission-mode|--approval|--approval-reviewer|--reviewer-model|--reviewer-timeout-ms|--autonomy|--scoped-rules|--sandbox|--filesystem|--add-dir|--trust-resources|--memory|--headless-policy|--verdict|--actor|--output|--scope|--prefix|--package-version|--base-url|--api|--api-key|--socket|--limit|--url|--header|--cwd|--env)
      COMPREPLY=()
      return 0
      ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--print --mode --json-schema --continue --session --fork --new-session --worktree --model --provider --thinking --tools --model-fallback --permission-mode --approval --approval-reviewer --reviewer-model --autonomy --sandbox --filesystem --add-dir --allow-unsandboxed-shell --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --trust --no-trust --trust-resources --bare --no-skills --no-plugins --no-mcp --memory --headless-policy --verdict --actor --json --limit --all-projects --socket --help --version" -- "$cur") )
  else
    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "resume sessions export attest pin sign memory setup models config doctor permissions trust capabilities mcp skills plugins daemon view completion install upgrade uninstall" -- "$cur") )
  fi
}
complete -F _codepunk_completion codepunk
